item.title: Bavar CAD/CAM Lab
item.description:
Bavar CAD/CAM Lab

BavarKam CAD/CAM Lab is a modern digital dental solution designed for precision, durability, and advanced laboratory performance.

Features

  • High precision digital design
  • Advanced 3D milling technology
  • Durable and aesthetic results
  • Suitable for modern dental clinics and labs

Applications

  • Crowns
  • Bridges
  • Veneers
  • Digital prosthetics

BavarKam delivers premium quality made in Afghanistan.

item.title: Face Cream
item.description:
Premium Face Cream by Face Dent

Our face cream is specially formulated to nourish and protect your skin. Made with natural ingredients suitable for all skin types.

Key Benefits

  • Deep hydration for 24 hours
  • Natural ingredients
  • Suitable for sensitive skin
  • Non-greasy formula
  • Dermatologically tested

How to Use

Apply a small amount to clean face and neck. Gently massage in circular motions until fully absorbed. Use twice daily for best results.

item.title: Face Wash
item.description:
Face Dent Face Wash

Experience the perfect start to your day with our refreshing face wash. Gently cleanses while maintaining your skin’s natural moisture balance.

Key Benefits

  • Deep pore cleansing
  • Removes impurities and excess oil
  • Maintains skin pH balance
  • Refreshing and cooling effect
  • Suitable for daily use

How to Use

Wet face with lukewarm water. Apply small amount and massage gently. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry. Use morning and evening.

item.title: Hand Cream
item.description:
Face Dent Hand Cream

Keep your hands soft, smooth, and protected with our nourishing hand cream. Perfect for daily use, especially in dry conditions.

Key Benefits

  • Intensive moisture
  • Quick absorption
  • Non-greasy formula
  • Protects from dryness
  • Long-lasting softness

How to Use

Apply small amount to hands and massage until fully absorbed. Reapply as needed, especially after washing hands.

Ingredients

Aqua, Glycerin, Shea Butter, Almond Oil, Vitamin E, Panthenol, Allantoin, Natural Fragrance

item.title: Kids Toothpaste & Toothbrush
item.description:
Face Dent Kids Dental Care

Make brushing fun with our specially designed toothpaste and toothbrush set for children. Safe, effective, and enjoyable for little ones.

Features

  • Toothpaste: Safe if swallowed, fluoride-free formula
  • Toothbrush: Soft bristles, small head for little mouths
  • Fun designs: Colorful and attractive for kids
  • Gentle cleaning: Protects developing teeth
  • Great taste: Kid-friendly flavors

Why Choose Our Kids Products

  • Pediatrician recommended
  • Free from harsh chemicals
  • Develops healthy brushing habits
  • Fun and engaging for children

Ingredients (Toothpaste)

Sorbitol, Aqua, Hydrated Silica, Xylitol, Glycerin, Natural Flavor, Xanthan Gum

item.title: Mouth Wash
item.description:
Face Dent Mouth Wash

Complete your oral care routine with our refreshing mouth wash. Fights bacteria, freshens breath, and promotes gum health.

Key Benefits

  • Kills 99.9% of bacteria
  • Long-lasting fresh breath
  • Strengthens enamel
  • Reduces plaque
  • Soothes gums

How to Use

Use twice daily after brushing. Pour 20ml (4 teaspoons) into cup. Rinse for 30 seconds and spit out. Do not swallow.

Ingredients

Aqua, Alcohol, Glycerin, Sorbitol, Menthol, Eucalyptol, Thymol, Methyl Salicylate, Benzoic Acid

item.title: Tooth Floss
item.description:
Face Dent Dental Floss

Reach where your toothbrush can’t with our high-quality dental floss. Essential for complete oral hygiene.

Key Benefits

  • Removes plaque between teeth
  • Prevents gum disease
  • Fresh mint flavor
  • Glides easily between teeth
  • Strong and shred-resistant

How to Use

Use 18 inches of floss. Wind around fingers and gently slide between teeth. Curve against tooth and scrape plaque away.

Features

  • Waxed for easy gliding
  • Mint flavor for fresh breath
  • Strong and durable
  • Compact travel-friendly container

item.title: Toothbrush
item.description:
Face Dent Toothbrush

Experience superior cleaning with our ergonomically designed toothbrush. Perfect for daily oral care.

Key Features

  • Soft bristles for gentle cleaning
  • Ergonomic non-slip handle
  • Multi-action bristle arrangement
  • Reaches back teeth easily
  • BPA-free materials

Bristle Types

  • Outer bristles: Longer for reaching between teeth
  • Inner bristles: Shorter for surface cleaning
  • Tip bristles: For back teeth cleaning

Usage Tips

Replace every 3 months or after illness. Rinse thoroughly after use. Store in upright position to dry.

item.title: Toothpaste
item.description:
Face Dent Toothpaste

Start your day with our fluoride toothpaste that provides complete protection against cavities, plaque, and bad breath.

Key Benefits

  • Cavity protection
  • Plaque prevention
  • Fresh breath
  • Enamel strengthening
  • Gentle whitening

How to Use

Brush twice daily for 2 minutes. Use pea-sized amount. Spit out, do not swallow. For best results, use with BavarKam toothbrush.

Ingredients

Sorbitol, Aqua, Hydrated Silica, Sodium Lauryl Sulfate, PEG-32, Sodium Fluoride, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Saccharin, Titanium Dioxide, Natural Mint Flavor
